page_title: WER 2-1 WOL | Werder Bremen v Wolfsburg 07/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+7' One of the players from Wolfsburg times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+6' The referee is firm and issues Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) a deserved yellow card.
90+4' 2 - 1 Goal! Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper inside the left post. 2:1.

90+1' It's unbelievable, Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) blows a huge opportunity! He is totally unmarked and fires a first-time shot towards the roof of the net, but Kamil Grabara reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

90' Victor Boniface (Werder Bremen) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the bottom left corner, but Kamil Grabara made an astonishing save!
90' The corner from Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) is hurriedly cleared.
89' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adam Daghim leaves the pitch and Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg) comes on.
87' It is time for a substitution. Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) is on for Christian Eriksen.
86' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Marco Grull.
86' Horst Steffen has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) replacing Senne Lynen.
85' Werder Bremen have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
84' Werder Bremen can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
83' The attendance for today's match is 42100.
83' 1 - 1 Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the right post. Excellent finish.
82' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Werder Bremen.
80' It will be a substitution. Isaac Schmidt (Werder Bremen) is ready to enter the pitch as Karim Coulibaly walks off.
80' Paul Simonis decides to make a substitution. Mohamed Amoura will be replaced by Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg).
79' Werder Bremen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
73' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
72' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 9:3.

71' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the left post. Kamil Grabara has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
70' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Wolfsburg.
67' Here's the change. Mattias Svanberg leaves the pitch and Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) comes on as a substitute.
65' Horst Steffen prepares a substitution. Justin Njinmah is replaced by Victor Boniface (Werder Bremen).
65' Substitution. Keke Topp leaves the pitch and is replaced by Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen).
65' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
62' Jenson Seelt (Wolfsburg) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Felix Zwayer who sees an offensive foul.
61' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
60' Werder Bremen control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
59' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) brings an opponent down and Felix Zwayer interrupts the game.
58' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
56' Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
52' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
51' A pass by Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
51' The corner is swung in but Werder Bremen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
51' Referee Felix Zwayer signals NO PENALTY for Werder Bremen after a VAR review!

50' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Werder Bremen.
50' Vini Souza (Wolfsburg) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
50' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
49' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
49' Mio Backhaus steps in and intercepts a long pass from Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg).
48' Werder Bremen take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
48' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen).
47' Werder Bremen quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
47' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Good movement by Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.

45+1' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) receives a quality pass and unleashes a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just over the crossbar. The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Wolfsburg work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
43' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
42' Felix Zwayer couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) and blew his whistle.
41' A pass by Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
40' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the bottom right corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Mio Backhaus.
39' The resulting set piece from Wolfsburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
38' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) sends a long ball in, but Mio Backhaus comfortably gathers the ball.
37' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
34' Werder Bremen are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
33' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Kamil Grabara scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.
33' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

32' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Kamil Grabara, who smothers the ball. Werder Bremen force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
31' Werder Bremen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
30' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
28' 0 - 1 What a hit! Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot inside the left post. 0:1.
27' The ball is cleared after Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
23' The current number of corner kicks is 3:0.
21' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for a foul after Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) hacks down one of his opponents.
20' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
17' The ball sits up nicely on the edge of the box for Marco Grull (Werder Bremen), but his powerful first-time shot flies well wide of the right post.
16' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
16' Neat passing move from Werder Bremen in order to create new attacking opportunities.
14' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.

13' Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he unleashed a powerful low shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the middle of the goal, but Mio Backhaus made a crucial save!
13' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
12' Wolfsburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
11' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Felix Zwayer stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
10' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
10' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
9' Some neat passing and movement from Werder Bremen as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
8' A lofted cross from Mio Backhaus (Werder Bremen) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
7' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
6' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Werder Bremen comes to nothing.

5' What a great chance for Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
4' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) will take a corner kick.

4' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Werder Bremen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
3' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
2' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Felix Zwayer saw the whole situation.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Werder Bremen will take the kick-off.
Felix Zwayer will referee today's match.
